Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: GovSec candidate shortlist + timing

Thanks Olivia — this is useful. Quick internal notes and asks before we proceed to interviews/offers:

1) Prioritization: we should prioritize Sr GRC Manager (Candidate A) and one Controls Engineer (Candidate B) this quarter; Staff SecEng (C) is a stretch given current HC limits.

2) Headcount ask: we are requesting a +1 HC reallocation for GRC (net neutral overall) — proposal is to move (1 FTE) from Platform Security (deferred infra projects) to GRC to accelerate FedRAMP readiness. See attached HC ramp sheet.

3) Offer bands: please confirm current approved bands for these roles. My expectation based on previous calibration:
  - Sr GRC Manager (L5): base $165k–185k, target TC $200k–230k
  - Security Controls Engineer (L4): base $135k–155k, TC $150k–185k
  - Staff SecEng (L6): base $210k–240k, TC 280k+ (we probably cannot reach that without a special approval)

4) Approvals needed: Vivek / Evelyn — can you confirm if we have budget headroom to reassign the HC this quarter and whether an exception is needed for any candidate whose total comp exceeds band? If yes, outline approval path (finance + CFO / People Ops).

5) Recruiting Ops (cc'd in a follow-up) — please hold off on any formal offers until we get the green light on the HC reallocation and band exceptions. We do want interview deconflicts this week.

Thanks — I'll triage interviews once I have confirmation.

-Hannah
Director, GRC Hiring Lead
Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Aug 2026 09:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: GovSec candidate shortlist + timing

Hannah —

I reviewed the HC ramp and candidate notes. High level: I authorize the reallocation of 1 FTE from Platform Security to GRC for Q3 hiring, with the following constraints:

- The transfer is contingent on Platform Security pausing the non-critical infra audit project (we will recover the work in Q1 2027).
- Any offer where total comp (incl. equity strike/expected value) exceeds the upper band above requires a one-off approval from Finance + People (loop in Marcus/Neha).
- Sign-on bonuses should be avoided except in exceptional counter-offer situations; capped at $15k with prior sign-off from Evelyn.
- For the Staff SecEng role, do not extend a full-market offer without a formal business case and exec sponsor; we should prefer internal leveling/strong justification.

Please proceed to schedule final-round interviews for Candidate A and B. If Recruiting Ops comes back with a comp ask out of band, escalate to me immediately — I'll fast-track approvals if the business case is airtight.

Vivek
VP, Platform & Security Operations
Redwood Inference

- Do not extend offers until we confirm any band exceptions. If candidate salary request falls within the band ranges noted below, Recruiting may proceed with verbal offers pending written approval:
  * Sr GRC Manager (L5): base $165k–185k; TC target $200k–230k
  * Security Controls Engineer (L4): base $135k–155k; TC target $150k–185k

- Sign-on: allowed only for counter-offers, max $15k (requires Evelyn sign-off).
- Equity: standard L5/L4 ranges apply — do not exceed 7% above midpoint without Vivek + Finance sign-off.
- Candidate C (Staff SecEng): put on hold for now; collect salary expectation and keep warm.

Attachments: Offer_Template_GovSec.docx (finalized template), GOVSEC_HC_Ramp_v2.xlsx

Thanks,
Hannah
